    Summary: Set against the treacherous backdrop of international gold syndicates in Dubai and Kerala, an enigmatic and ruthless underworld ruler faces syndicate betrayals, corrupt enforcement, and bloodline vengeance. Source:IMDB

    Plot

    Set across international borders between Dubai and Kerala, Khalifa chronicles the rise of an enigmatic underworld kingpin who commands the cross-border gold trade. As rival syndicate bosses and treacherous power brokers plot his downfall, Khalifa unleashes a ruthless counter-offensive to protect his empire and avenge his bloodline. Source:IMDB
